mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_project_member m JOIN sys_project_member_role mr ON mr.project_id = m.project_id AND mr.user_id = m.user_id JOIN sys_project_role r ON r.id = mr.role_id AND r.project_id = m.project_id WHERE m.project_id = #{projectId} AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.role_code = 'project-admin'
